subject: The flight deck of the colony ship ariadne at night, two officers on watch, stars in the big window. Mac's two years are up at the end of the month, and he doesn't want to go under. "Years at a time with the instruments running and nobody reading them, think what goes past while I'm asleep, no, think what we're missing right now, let me stay up through the next watch, one more year, and I'll go under after, I promise I'll go under." Only these two officers are seen clearly; the other four at the table or on the ship are faceless: backs turned, in shadow or cut off by the frame.
